title: A Robin En El Hood
style: Phonk bounce, hyper-speed electronic trap with heavy rolling phonk drums, deep 808s, siren samples, police radio chatter SFX, vinyl crackle, chopped ad-libs, energetic male rap verses and big melodic chorus hooks; cyberpunk heist energy with 336 Hz signal pulses, bright triumphant synth lift on the final chorus, gritty but playful, wide and punchy mix, bounce, fake, playful, electronic trap, bright, deep, rap, rock
lyrics:
[Intro]
Unit 336… Math Driver online…
Delta Alpha plan engaged…
Hyperspeed… go!
Ey, vámonos

[Verse 1]
Phonk track bounce, here’s my crew
Thrash this toy, take the right lane, boo
Hyper speed plane, sirens in the blue
Unit 336, ya tú sabes, we move
A robin, a robin, out the mansion
Fake a break, chase and cage, no transaction
Extra stripe for no rage, puro action
Robin in the hood, but it’s for good
Bust ’em like we should, qué locura
Ha bro, if we could, pura altura
You heard the sarg — chase and cage
Thrash this toy, catch that boy
Phonky sneaky phonk, thrift drift kick
Cuidado, rápido, click-clack flick
Oye, math driver, keep it tight
We slide that dark to the morning light

[Pre-Chorus]
Free birds rapping it back, hear them sing
336 Hz, that signal rings
Cash back drop, what a shock
Chase and cage, then we unlock
Ándale, ándale, don’t look down
We run that loop all through the town

[Chorus]
A robin in the hood
A robin in the hood
A robin in the hood
Ah, robin for good!
Math Driver — delta alpha plan
Hyperspeed, sí, we got the jam
You got this, we believe
Math Driver, the architect
The plan, the dream — done safe, done sound
Our robin, our robin, our robin in our hood

[Verse 2]
Sandbox City, eyes full of sand
An unreal land, where are my toys?
Bored stare like we care, hand in hand
Groundhog day, sandbox say, no choice
But I forget what 8 is for
Words spun, querido, without the fear
Math Driver! VDS Mansion!
We go now — Hyperspeed, sincere
No way back, we go to stay
Escape this place, don’t fade away
Thrash this toy, G4 hyper speed
You got this, boy, with your G4 need
Delta alpha track, DJ Zyn Rose
We got this, compa, everybody knows
Pedals everywhere, dust and chrome
We tear that maze and take it home

[Chorus]
A robin in the hood
A robin in the hood
A robin in the hood
Ah, robin for good!
Escaping hyperspeed, no more cage
Sandbox City, Sandbox City on stage
VDS Mansion party for me
VDS Mansion party for me
A robin in the hood
A robin in the hood
A robin in the hood
Ah, robin for good!

[Bridge]
Mirrors reflecting the plan
Hyperspeed burning through the cage
Sirens fading in the rear view
336 signal guiding the way
Math Driver — we did it safe, we did it sound
Robin in the hood, and we’re home now
Sí, lo hicimos

[Final Chorus]
A robin in the hood (for good!)
VDS Mansion party for me! (hey)
VDS Mansion party for me! (yeah)
Escaping hyperspeed — no more cage!
A robin in the hood (for good!)
No more sandbox, we break that page
Math Driver — delta alpha plan
Our robin, our robin, our robin in the hood
Ey, ey, ey
Sí, sí, sí
3 3 6
VDS Mansion lit
Singing it back, we’re out that pit
